architecture_references.notes: The integrated CohereAsr configuration, FastConformer compatibility, decoder equations, feature extraction, prompt construction, and long-form chunk semantics were audited at this immutable revision. VoiceHub imports none of Transformers at runtime.

Cohere's original remote-code configuration, model, processor, tokenizer, model card, and exact gated Safetensors header were audited at this immutable model revision. Repository Python is never executed.

tokenizer_references.notes: BPE merge order, byte fallback, added-token matching, decoder fusion, and identity post-processing.
SentencePiece precompiled normalization character-map format and Darts-trie traversal.

inference: 16 kHz deterministic dither, pre-emphasis, log-mel extraction, and per-feature normalization
eight-layer, 1024-wide causal decoder with encoder cross-attention
source-verified quiet-boundary long-form segmentation and language-aware text joining
strict Safetensors header verification and portable sharded reload
training: raw waveform, language, punctuation, and transcript preparation
coherent shifted teacher-forcing inputs and padding-masked cross-entropy
limitations: Only Safetensors checkpoints with the Cohere conditional-generation graph are accepted.
Only greedy decoding is implemented; beam search, sampling, hotwords, timestamps, diarization, translation, and language detection fail closed.
The language must be one of the 14 source-verified language codes.
Long-form splitting is offline quiet-boundary segmentation, not streaming and not literal overlap.
KV-cache generation is not exposed until cache parity is independently verified.
No corpus-level WER benchmark was run, so no accuracy improvement over Cohere's published checkpoint is claimed.
